Title: Some users may experience delays or failures when receiving responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot 

User impact: Users may experience delays or failures when receiving responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot. 

More info: Affected users may encounter error responses, delayed completions, or requests that fail to complete when using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Declarative Agents, and Copilot for Education experiences. 

Current status: We're reviewing service monitoring telemetry to isolate the root cause and determine our next troubleshooting steps. 

Scope of impact: Impact is specific to some users attempting to receive responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Declarative Agents, and Copilot for Education experiences. 

Next update by: Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 11:30 AM UTC

Title: Some users may have experienced delays or failures when receiving responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot

User impact: Users may have experienced delays or failures when receiving responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot.

More info: Affected users may have encountered error responses, delayed completions, or requests that failed to complete when using Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Declarative Agents, and Copilot for Education experiences.

Final status: We've determined that an unexpected increase in request volume overwhelmed a portion of the infrastructure responsible for processing Copilot requests, resulting in impact. While we were in the process of reviewing available mitigation options to restore services, system monitoring indicated that service had recovered. We've monitored service health for an extended period of time and confirmed that the issue is no longer occurring.

Scope of impact: Impact was specific to some users attempting to receive responses from Microsoft 365 Copilot, Copilot Chat, Declarative Agents, and Copilot for Education experiences.

Start time: Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 7:50 AM UTC

End time: Tuesday, September 1, 2026, at 9:10 AM UTC

Root cause: An unexpected increase in request volume overwhelmed a portion of the infrastructure responsible for processing Copilot requests, resulting in impact.

Next steps: 
- We're analyzing performance data and trends on the affected infrastructure to help prevent this problem from happening again. 

This is the final update for the event.
